content.text:
*I dust off my hands and survey the rocky terrain around me. Mining materials everywhere, but that's not really what I'm after.*

Well, I found what's here - iron and copper ore. Decent quality too, especially that copper. But I'm more interested in herbs and plants for medicine than digging up rocks. The forest might be more my speed for that kind of work.

*I glance over at Bob, then check my energy levels*

I've got enough energy left to make a move and do some real foraging work. Time to head somewhere more... green.
